findings.evidence: `rg -n "@\[simp\]|lemma fractionalIdealDivisor"` shows `@[simp]` only at lines 92 and 151, while the characteristic lemmas are introduced without attributes at lines 160, 177, 187, and 194.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these normal-form lemmas, matching the existing `@[simp]` annotations on `coeff_fractionalIdealDivisor` and `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply`.
findings.issue: The characteristic rewrite lemmas `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_symm_apply`, `fractionalIdealDivisor_toPrincipalIdeal`, `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_toPrincipalIdeal`, and `fractionalIdealDivisor_asIdeal` are plain lemmas instead of simp lemmas.

summary: The new divisor map and equivalence have the expected characteristic lemmas, but several normal-form lemmas are public without automation annotations, leaving downstream users to rewrite the new API manually.
